title: Reserve Our Low Tide Flat | Rosemary Beach Cottage Rentals | Rosemary Beach – Rosemary Beach®
meta_description: Make this exquisite beach house your own luxury beachfront vacation rental. Low tide flat is in one of the most desirable areas of Rosemary Beach, meaning more room to relax and play!
description_expanded:
Property includes dedicated Rosemary Beach® community Beach Access via 9 Private Beach Walkovers. Beach chair service available for an additional cost through RBPOA Beach Service. Complimentary access to Rosemary Beach® Fitness and complimentary court time at Rosemary Beach® Racquet Club also included.

When we go on vacation, we often want to stay somewhere that is quiet, cozy, and which feels like we are truly in a home. For this reason, instead of the typical hotel, many instead opt for the option of the vacation rental, which allows one to have all the usefulness of a hotel, but with all the freedom and luxury of home. Well, if you are looking for someplace to rest your weary legs, but are looking for something a bit homier, look no further than the Low Tide Flat !

The Living Areas

This 2-bed, 2-bath home stretches for 1,122 square feet and can hold of a total of six guests, making it a perfect retreat for those traveling with a group of friends, or family who you might not get to see as often as one would like. As you walk up to the door, one of the first things that you will notice is the lovely porch complete with a sitting area for you to sip your morning coffee as you watch the sun rise above the horizon. Walking within, you'll notice cream walls with blue accents that give the rental the feeling of the sea, and with hardwood floors you'll find it offers not only the relaxation of the coast but also an atmosphere of elegance. Thanks to the open floor plan, you'll never feel crowed as you relax about the comfortable sitting room complete with a queen-sized sleeper sofa should you need it. You'll also find an elegant dining area complete with farm style table, along with a chandelier dangling above to light up your feast. You'll find across from you the kitchen, complete with breakfast bar, granite counters, and all the equipment one might find themselves needing to create a culinary masterpiece.

The Bedrooms

As you continue to explore your new home, you'll find the guest bedroom complete with two twin beds. You'll also find the guest bath which includes a wide vanity sink as well as a tub/shower combination. Nearby you'll find the master bedroom, which is complete with a king bed, as well as a cozy rocking chair in the corner that gives it the feel of grandma's house (in the best way possible). You'll also find the master bathroom which comes complete with a walk-in shower as well as a double vanity sink. Finally, as you complete your walk-through of your temporary home, you might notice the washer and dryer tucked away, which anyone who has had to depend on laundromats can attest is quite the luxury.

Parking behind building for one vehicle.

As one can see, the Low Tide Flat is a lovely, and elegant, rental that is perfect for a family to call their own on their next adventure. So, if you find your interest piqued, or if you are curious about what other rentals we might have tucked away, waiting to be discovered, make sure you give Rosemary Beach a call today at (866) 348-8952 today!

**This property requires a 4 night minimum stay during spring break and summer and a 2 night minimum stay during shoulder season.
